item.title: NASA clears its Artemis moon rocket for an April launch with four astronauts following repairs
item.description: NASA cleared its moon rocket on Thursday for an April launch with four astronauts after completing the latest round of repairs.

item.title: Dispute between defense lawyers prompts closed hearing in 41-year-old death penalty case
item.description: Attorneys in the death penalty case against Doug Lovell for the 1985 murder of Joyce Yost will be in court this week, but the public won't be allowed to attend.

item.title: UDOT announces interstate closure, construction projects this weekend
item.description: Multiple scheduled closures will take place this weekend along Interstate 15 as the Utah Department of Transportation installs steel support beams for the new 4400 South bridge and pours concrete for multiple bridges.

item.title: Iran-linked hackers take aim at US and other targets, raising risk of cyberattacks during war
item.description: Pro-Iranian hackers are targeting sites in the Middle East and starting to stretch into the United States during the war.

item.title: Here’s who is running for each of Utah’s 4 congressional seats
item.description: Candidates who are running can qualify for the primary ballot by winning a certain percentage of votes during the nominating convention or by collecting 7,000 signatures. Utah's primaries are on June 23, and Election Day is Nov. 3.

item.title: Testimony concludes in Kouri Richins murder trial as defense opts not to call witnesses
item.description: No more witnesses will be called in the Park City murder trial for Kouri Richins, a Kamas mother accused of fatally poisoning her husband.

item.title: Increased DUI enforcement blitzes during St. Patrick’s Day weekend, said DPS
item.description: Those planning on celebrating St. Patrick's Day with holiday drinking should ensure they have designated drivers. Not only will it help protect other drivers on the road, it will prevent police officers from arresting drunk drivers during their enforcement blitz this weekend.

item.title: Fire burning off I-15 in Utah County human caused, agency said
item.description: A large fire was burning in a field in North Springville near exit 260 off of Interstate 15 on Thursday.

item.title: Lawyers in landmark social media addiction trial make final appeals to the jury
item.description: Twelve jurors heard closing arguments in a case that could determine whether social media companies should be liable for harms caused to children using their platforms.

item.title: ICE buys Salt Lake City warehouse, sparking concern an immigrant detention center is coming
item.description: ICE has bought a Salt Lake City warehouse, sparking concern an immigrant detention center is coming.
